svg.aria-label: The journey: a spiral growing by phi every quarter turn, from the Age of Reason at the centre to the Age of Engagement. Each turn is a 4D loop: discover, develop, design, deploy. A Business Equation reading at every discover. You transform your people, to transition your organisation, to transcend your market.
svg.title: The journey
svg.text: loops inside loops, at every scale
The Translator walks it with you.
